_description: Real drone recordings (Marzena Mięsikowska, drone_only, no voice) instead of synthetic drones. 20 MAD clips each for ambient_outdoor (footsteps), explosion (shelling) and vehicle_mechanical (vehicles), all no-drone. The same ambient and explosion windows again with a real drone over them (pairs; vehicles never get a drone). Plus 20 drone clips with no background.
name: mm_real_drones_20
comment: Real MM drone recordings (drone_only, no voice) with and without MAD background. 20 no-drone MAD clips per class (footsteps, shelling, vehicles); ambient and explosion clips also exported with a real drone over the same window; 20 drone-only clips. Drone over MAD at median SNR about -5 dB.
